race.comment: NOTGUILTY (3) has not raced for ten months. Looks forward enough for this return after winning in a recent trial. No excuses from this advantageous draw and expecting a bright start to the campaign. BETTER THEN DAICOS (6) just missed the frame last time when he finished fourth over 2240m at Melton, beaten 30 metres. Tackles an easier assignment and he can discover winning ways. LAMBRO BUOY (1) disappointed last time when eighth over 1690m at Kilmore. Can atone from the coveted pegs draw. I WANT MARY (7) is worth some thought despite her last-start tenth over 1790m at this track on August 7. Watch for a spike in form.
